# SK Hynix P51 Platinum 2 TB Review - Impressive Performance

by 

W1zzard (w1zzard@techpowerup.com)

on Oct 2nd, 2025, 

## Introduction

 SK hynix is a leading global manufacturer of memory and storage solutions, best known for DRAM and NAND flash. With its 2020 acquisition of Intel's NAND and SSD business (now Solidigm), the company strengthened its position in the SSD market. Today, SK hynix concentrates on NAND and SSD products, whereas Solidigm operates independently, focusing solely on enterprise SSDs and no longer on consumer SSDs. 

 The SK Hynix P51 Platinum was originally released last year, but it is only now reaching the Western markets in the US and Europe. With SK Hynix's extensive product range, this SSD stands out as one of the few where all major components, including the NAND flash, SSD controller, and DRAM cache, are manufactured by the same company—SK Hynix. With Micron and Sandisk/WD switching to third-party controllers, Samsung is the only competitor remaining with such an ability. As controller, SK Hynix is using their new Alistar ACNT093 controller, which is used exclusively on the P51 Platinum. The NAND flash is SK Hynix's own 238-layer 3D TLC NAND, and the DRAM cache chip is a 4 GB LPDDR4X-4266 chip that we've seen on many other SSDs in the past. The SK Hynix P51 Platinum SSD is available in capacities of 500 GB (unknown), 1 TB ($155) and 2 TB ($230). The endurance is set to 300 TBW, 600 TBW and 1200 TBW respectively. SK Hynix includes a five-year warranty with the P51 Platinum SSD.
